# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

[Learn More][63]
 
 

# Join Our Team

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

[Learn More][64]
 
 

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

[Learn More][68]
 
 

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

[Learn More][69]
 
 

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

[Learn More][70]
 

# ATG’s Master Brands

Apex Tool Group manufactures leading hand and power tool brands around the world.

## Skycatch Acquisition Expands Mining Technology

Caterpillar has acquired Skycatch, a leading provider of spatial data capture, processing and
analysis solutions for the mining industry.

Donations to the Smithsonian and Points of Light will help equip the next generation with in-demand
skills and mobilize Caterpillar employee community service.

## Caterpillar Foundation Supports Venezuela Earthquake Recovery

The Caterpillar Foundation donated $250,000 to support earthquake recovery efforts in Venezuela.

[ callView Release][225]

Caterpillar launches a Texas workforce commitment with up to $5 million in funding to prepare
workers for advanced manufacturing and industry technician careers.

shaping the future as the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment,
off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.

## Solutions

defined by their extensive scope, substantial budgets, and prolonged timelines. From sprawling
manufacturing plants and expansive data centers to massive infrastructure initiatives, megasites
represent significant investments where efficiency, reliability, and innovation are paramount.

[Arrow]

attached to your jobsite.

### On-site Facilities

[Arrow]

to support your project.

### Site Access & Security

[Arrow]

Safeguard your site and valuable assets by controlling access with our fencing, security turnstiles,
and more.

### Connectivity & Communications

[Arrow]

across your site.

### Tool Rooms & Trailers

[Arrow]

Fully managed tooling programs can flex in size to fit your needs, allowing you to worry less about
tool loss and overall costs.

### Fuel & Charging

[Arrow]

Our on-site fueling and charging services keep your fleet moving, saving time and reducing costs.

### Wash Bays

[Arrow]

# Sampling & Testing Tools

Ever since 1942, we have been a leader in manufacturing soil sampling equipment for agricultural,
geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater applications. Our extensive product line also includes
equipment for soil gas sampling, sludge and sediment sampling, geotechnical sampling and testing,
and groundwater sampling and monitoring.

Our soil sampling equipment includes soil probes, soil augers, soil core samplers, and more. For
soil gas sampling tools, we supply gas vapor implants and gas vapor probe samplers. Our sludge and
sediment sampling tools include sand and sediment probes, core samplers, dredges, and more. For
geotechnical sampling and testing tools, we offer infiltration rings, pocket penetrometers, dynamic
cone penetrometers, and more. And lastly, our groundwater sampling and monitoring equipment includes
bailers, product interface and water level meters, peristaltic pumps, and more.

Before diving into your next project, make sure you have the right sampling and testing tools ready
to go. With our equipment, you can collect accurate and reliable data, allowing you to confidently
make well-informed decisions. Browse our official online store today for your project.

# Sampling & Testing Tools

Ever since 1942, we have been a leader in manufacturing soil sampling equipment for agricultural,
geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater applications. Our extensive product line also includes
equipment for soil gas sampling, sludge and sediment sampling, geotechnical sampling and testing,
and groundwater sampling and monitoring.

Our soil sampling equipment includes soil probes, soil augers, soil core samplers, and more. For
soil gas sampling tools, we supply gas vapor implants and gas vapor probe samplers. Our sludge and
sediment sampling tools include sand and sediment probes, core samplers, dredges, and more. For
geotechnical sampling and testing tools, we offer infiltration rings, pocket penetrometers, dynamic
cone penetrometers, and more. And lastly, our groundwater sampling and monitoring equipment includes
bailers, product interface and water level meters, peristaltic pumps, and more.

Before diving into your next project, make sure you have the right sampling and testing tools ready
to go. With our equipment, you can collect accurate and reliable data, allowing you to confidently
make well-informed decisions. Browse our official online store today for your project.

### CHINA KOMAL INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD

CHINA KOMAL INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD is a professional international enterprise specializing in the
R&D, manufacturing and sales of oilfield equipment. Established in 2010, the company is
headquartered in Beijing and owns a modern production base and a comprehensive sales network.

Main products include: petroleum equipment, solids control systems, mud pump parts, shaker screens,
and high pressure pumps. Our products are widely used in the fields of oil and natural gas
exploration and development, and are exported to the Middle East, North America, South America,
Southeast Asia and other regions, highly trusted by customers worldwide.

Connoils By Kraft is a leading international supplement [manufacturer][93], [distributor][94]
and [wholesale supplier][95] of bulk oil ingredients. We create [oil and oil powders][96] meeting
food, nutritional and drink grade standards. Connoils By Kraft clients range from startups to big
multinational corporations creating gels, [capsules][97], pills, [dried beverages][98],
[tablets][99], [drinks][100] and more. Connoils By Kraft can help any business create oil and oil
powder based product to stringent domestic or international specifications.

## We Buy, Grow or Source Oil & Oil Powder Products

We’ve worked with manufacturers and companies in the [pet nutrition][101], [functional food][102],
health, [beauty][103] and [sports nutrition][104] industries, providing customized formulations with
the highest potency available. Our [experienced formulators][105] draw on industry leading training
and technology to bring your product beyond the standards of regulatory compliance.

[Get Started][106]

### A Single-Source Custom Supplier

We’re competitively priced in [oils and oil powders][107]. Through our Peterson Plant Products (PPP)
company, we plant or source conventional, organic and biodynamic products with full traceability and
documentation, ensuring you meet the regulatory standards of your industry.

[Custom Formulation][108]

### Cutting-Edge Drying Technology Increases Ingredient Potency

By minimizing the use of heat in transforming oils into oil powders, Connoils By Kraft maximizes the
nutritional integrity of your product through microencapsulation. We're able to create high oil load
oil powders that are more potent than those from [manufacturers][109] that use traditional drying
processes.

# Raw Ingredients To Finished Products

Connoils By Kraft is a leading international supplement [manufacturer][93], [distributor][94]
and [wholesale supplier][95] of bulk oil ingredients. We create [oil and oil powders][96] meeting
food, nutritional and drink grade standards. Connoils By Kraft clients range from startups to big
multinational corporations creating gels, [capsules][97], pills, [dried beverages][98],
[tablets][99], [drinks][100] and more. Connoils By Kraft can help any business create oil and oil
powder based product to stringent domestic or international specifications.

## We Buy, Grow or Source Oil & Oil Powder Products

We’ve worked with manufacturers and companies in the [pet nutrition][101], [functional food][102],
health, [beauty][103] and [sports nutrition][104] industries, providing customized formulations with
the highest potency available. Our [experienced formulators][105] draw on industry leading training
and technology to bring your product beyond the standards of regulatory compliance.

[Get Started][106]

### A Single-Source Custom Supplier

We’re competitively priced in [oils and oil powders][107]. Through our Peterson Plant Products (PPP)
company, we plant or source conventional, organic and biodynamic products with full traceability and
documentation, ensuring you meet the regulatory standards of your industry.

[Custom Formulation][108]

### Cutting-Edge Drying Technology Increases Ingredient Potency

By minimizing the use of heat in transforming oils into oil powders, Connoils By Kraft maximizes the
nutritional integrity of your product through microencapsulation. We're able to create high oil load
oil powders that are more potent than those from [manufacturers][109] that use traditional drying
processes.

## Get Your Product To Market, *Faster*

Our customers require the flexibility to order small and large raw materials quantities. From high
oil load powders and bioactive powders with improved absorption and uptake, Connoils By Kraft
provides superior customer service, on-time delivery and price competitiveness. As a toll processor,
we can take any element (from a raw ingredient to a finished product) through our formulation
process, [private labeling/white labeling][111] and shipping direct.

## Oils & Oil Powders for Every Industry

National and international manufacturers, companies and distributors choose Connoils By Kraft for
non-gmo, organic oil and oil powder. Consumers choose our oils and oil powders for their products as

## Let's Build Your Drilling Solution

Provide our engineering team with your project specifications to receive a detailed quotation and
technical proposal. We are prepared to support your needs, from standard tool supply to fully
custom-engineered solutions.

[ Get a Quote Today ][61]
HAVE QUESTIONS?

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What is the advantage of sourcing directly from a manufacturer?

A: Sourcing directly allows for better quality control, as we oversee the entire production process.
It also facilitates clear communication for technical support and custom engineering requirements.

### Q: How do you ensure quality during the manufacturing process?

A: We implement a multi-stage quality control system. This includes raw material inspection,
in-process checks at critical manufacturing stages, and a comprehensive final inspection before
shipment.

### Q: Do your tools align with common industry practices?

A: Our engineering and manufacturing processes are based on established best practices within the
foundation drilling industry, focusing on achieving reliability, durability, and operational
efficiency.

### Q: What is the general process for ordering a custom drilling tool?

A: The process typically begins with a technical consultation to define your needs. Our engineers
then create a design proposal for your review and approval before manufacturing commences.

### Q: How is the lead time for an order determined?

A: Lead times are based on product type and the extent of customization. We maintain a stock of
common standard components to help expedite orders and provide a clear delivery schedule for all
custom projects.

### Q: How do you ensure a new tool will be compatible with my drill rig?

A: To ensure proper fitment, our team will work with you to confirm your drill rig’s key
specifications, such as the Kelly Box type and dimensions, as a critical step in the design process.

### Q: What information should I provide to get an accurate quote?

A: For the most accurate quote, please provide the type of tool needed (e.g., auger, bucket), the
required dimensions, the general ground conditions you face, and the model of your drill rig.

### Q: What kind of technical support is available after purchase?

A: We provide ongoing technical support for our products. Should you have questions regarding
operation, maintenance, or performance optimization, our experienced team is available to offer
professional guidance.

[ Get a Quote Today ][61]
HAVE QUESTIONS?

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What is the advantage of sourcing directly from a manufacturer?

A: Sourcing directly allows for better quality control, as we oversee the entire production process.
It also facilitates clear communication for technical support and custom engineering requirements.

### Q: How do you ensure quality during the manufacturing process?

A: We implement a multi-stage quality control system. This includes raw material inspection,
in-process checks at critical manufacturing stages, and a comprehensive final inspection before
shipment.

### Q: Do your tools align with common industry practices?

A: Our engineering and manufacturing processes are based on established best practices within the
foundation drilling industry, focusing on achieving reliability, durability, and operational
efficiency.

### Q: What is the general process for ordering a custom drilling tool?

A: The process typically begins with a technical consultation to define your needs. Our engineers
then create a design proposal for your review and approval before manufacturing commences.

### Q: How is the lead time for an order determined?

A: Lead times are based on product type and the extent of customization. We maintain a stock of
common standard components to help expedite orders and provide a clear delivery schedule for all
custom projects.

### Q: How do you ensure a new tool will be compatible with my drill rig?

A: To ensure proper fitment, our team will work with you to confirm your drill rig’s key
specifications, such as the Kelly Box type and dimensions, as a critical step in the design process.

### Q: What information should I provide to get an accurate quote?

A: For the most accurate quote, please provide the type of tool needed (e.g., auger, bucket), the
required dimensions, the general ground conditions you face, and the model of your drill rig.

### Q: What kind of technical support is available after purchase?

A: We provide ongoing technical support for our products. Should you have questions regarding
operation, maintenance, or performance optimization, our experienced team is available to offer
professional guidance.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Dmytro Shulha
CEO and Founder of GetProspect

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

Please, let me know if we can do something even better.

# Product series

Hengwang's main products include four major categories and over 40 types, such as drilling rigs,
pile drivers, construction machinery, and parts. Relying on technological innovation, the company
continues to achieve breakthroughs in the fields of new energy and intelligent modification.

[
Learn more
][115]
[

### Construction Machinery

Hengwang Group's construction machinery business encompasses excavators, road rollers, loaders,
forklifts, and transport vehicles. With a global presence, the company has established production,
sales, and distribution networks worldwide, catering to a wide range of engineering needs.

Learn more
][116]
[

### Drilling Rig

This includes various drilling equipment such as pneumatic, hydraulic, borehole, and exploration
equipment. The products exhibit excellent performance and reliability, making them suitable for
various geological exploration, engineering drilling, and multi-sector needs.

Learn more
][117]
[

### Pile Driver

We produce various pile foundation equipment, including photovoltaic pile drivers, guardrail pile
drivers, drilling rigs, auger excavators, and more, providing reliable solutions for a wide range of
foundation engineering projects.

Learn more
][118]
[

### Parts

Components form the core of the equipment, directly determining the equipment's performance,
reliability, and lifespan. We adhere to the principles of employing advanced manufacturing
techniques and high-quality materials, ensuring that each component undergoes rigorous quality
control and testing.

Learn more

the summer and fall.  This bait can be used in a variety of ways including dog proofs and cage
traps.  The sweet smell doesn't attract domestic animals like fish type lures do.  A great choice
for ADC work! 8oz jar.

the summer and fall.  This bait can be used in a variety of ways including dog proofs and cage
traps.  The sweet smell doesn't attract domestic animals like fish type lures do.  A great choice
for ADC work! 8oz jar.

# Murray’s Lures & Trapping Supplies

## Lure & Trapping Supply Store

est. 1993

Thanks for stopping by Murray’s Lures & Trapping Supplies, your number one online trappers shop
coming to you from Walker, West Virginia. We’re a proud, family-owned company that’s been catering
to our loyal customers since 1993 with our own special brand of top-quality products and service.
Murray’s lure & trapping supply store is run by trappers for trappers, and we only offer items for
sale that we would (and do) use ourselves! That means at our trapping supply company you’ll find
nothing but the best materials, and if by some chance you’re not fully satisfied with anything you
get from our online trapping store, just let us know and we’ll make it right with a refund.

In addition to our fully stocked bait and lure shop, we also maintain a huge inventory of other
trapping supplies such as [traps][150], [snares][151] and trapline accessories. You’ll also find a
comprehensive collection of [fur-handling][152] and finishing supplies and a nice library of books
and videos by numerous experts in the field. Also check out our awesome selection of outdoor
clothing, pistol and rifle vaults, and emergency survival supplies.

We continually restock our products and add new items, so make sure you check back with us
frequently. Besides our wide variety of baits, lures and other types of hunting supplies, Murray’s
thrives by placing customer needs before all else.

We stand behind our products, keeping the trapper foremost in mind. If for any reason you are
dissatisfied with one of our products, simply return it for a full refund (shipping excluded in some
situations). Make sure you check out our schedule of upcoming convention appearances where you can
meet us and shop for some of our products in person. Thank you for choosing Murray’s for all of your
hunting and trapping needs.

# Murray’s Lures & Trapping Supplies

## Lure & Trapping Supply Store

est. 1993

Thanks for stopping by Murray’s Lures & Trapping Supplies, your number one online trappers shop
coming to you from Walker, West Virginia. We’re a proud, family-owned company that’s been catering
to our loyal customers since 1993 with our own special brand of top-quality products and service.
Murray’s lure & trapping supply store is run by trappers for trappers, and we only offer items for
sale that we would (and do) use ourselves! That means at our trapping supply company you’ll find
nothing but the best materials, and if by some chance you’re not fully satisfied with anything you
get from our online trapping store, just let us know and we’ll make it right with a refund.

In addition to our fully stocked bait and lure shop, we also maintain a huge inventory of other
trapping supplies such as [traps][150], [snares][151] and trapline accessories. You’ll also find a
comprehensive collection of [fur-handling][152] and finishing supplies and a nice library of books
and videos by numerous experts in the field. Also check out our awesome selection of outdoor
clothing, pistol and rifle vaults, and emergency survival supplies.

We continually restock our products and add new items, so make sure you check back with us
frequently. Besides our wide variety of baits, lures and other types of hunting supplies, Murray’s
thrives by placing customer needs before all else.

We stand behind our products, keeping the trapper foremost in mind. If for any reason you are
dissatisfied with one of our products, simply return it for a full refund (shipping excluded in some
situations). Make sure you check out our schedule of upcoming convention appearances where you can
meet us and shop for some of our products in person. Thank you for choosing Murray’s for all of your
hunting and trapping needs.

You’ve just stumbled upon OpenCorporates, a vast repository of corporate data, and you’re wondering,

# Your Go-To Source for Pest Control Solutions

At PcsOutdoors, we take pride in being a leading provider of premium trapping supplies, predator
hunting gear, and pest control solutions across the United States. Our commitment to excellence and
innovation has earned us the reputation of being a go-to resource for outdoor enthusiasts and
wildlife management professionals.
[[The Hunter]][107]
[[Racoon Trap]][108]

## Trapping Supplies for Every Need

Whether you're targeting coyotes, foxes, beavers, bobcats, or opossums, our extensive range of
trapping supplies has you covered. From body grip traps to specialized equipment for nuisance animal
control, we offer a comprehensive selection of products to meet your trapping requirements.
Moreover, our AuSable® brand is proudly made in the USA, ensuring top-notch quality and reliability.

[Trapping Supplies][109]

## Check out our hunting products.

[Visit Us][110][Facebook][111][YouTube][112]
[][113][][114]

## Unparalleled Predator Hunting Equipment

For those passionate about predator hunting, we offer diverse professional-grade supplies to enhance
your outdoor adventures. Our predator hunting range includes top-quality gear designed to elevate
your hunting experiences and maximize your success in the field.

## National and Canadian Distribution

Proud Distribution We are proud to offer distribution of our products, allowing outdoor enthusiasts
and wildlife professionals access to our superior trapping and [predator hunting solutions][116].

[[Hunter]][117]

Follow us on [Facebook][118] to stay informed and engaged with [PcsOutdoors][119]. Our social media

and unmatched customer service.

## Sterling Fur Company

Sterling Fur Company has always been a family operation. Although many of our employees are not
relatives, the philosophy is the same; to treat both customers and employees as family. Our success
as a business has been made possible by our many customers. Our company would not exist without
them, and we are so grateful.

The vision of Sterling Fur Company has gone from just an idea to a national trapping supply company.
There is no other dealer who compares to the selection, volume, and service that we offer. Trapping
is part of our heritage. From the line-trapper to the state and national associations and
publications, each of us plays an integral part in keeping this heritage alive today. I thank you
for your continued support and look forward to serving your trapping supply needs in the years ahead

**Thank you,
Keith Winkler
Sterling Fur Company**

## Sterling Fur Company

Sterling Fur Company has always been a family operation. Although many of our employees are not
relatives, the philosophy is the same; to treat both customers and employees as family. Our success
as a business has been made possible by our many customers. Our company would not exist without
them, and we are so grateful.

The vision of Sterling Fur Company has gone from just an idea to a national trapping supply company.
There is no other dealer who compares to the selection, volume, and service that we offer. Trapping
is part of our heritage. From the line-trapper to the state and national associations and
publications, each of us plays an integral part in keeping this heritage alive today. I thank you
for your continued support and look forward to serving your trapping supply needs in the years ahead

**Thank you,
Keith Winkler
Sterling Fur Company**

# Thermion corporation

[favicon]

Our forte & focus since inception in 2012 have always centered around the Infrastructure, Steel,
Cement, Oil & Gas and the Mining industry. Manufacturing of Foundation  Drilling Tools,
Hydraulic/Mechanical Grabs, Telescopic Kelly Bars, Spares & Accessories for all OEM Hydraulic Rigs,
Supply of High Performance Drilling Bits & Wear parts, Supply of Critical Maintenance & Repair
Welding Alloys.


Our Steel Industry business comprises the following product lines:

Blast Furnace Charging Equipment – Tuyere Stock Assembly, Blow Pipe & Elbow Assembly (Single Lance
and Double Lance), Metallic Bellows Expansion Joints, Fabric Expansion Joints, Metal Hoses, High
Pressure Wear Resistant Metallic Hoses for Pulverised Coal, Double Jacket Gaskets, Fluorosilicon
Rubber Seals for Bleeder, Relief & Equalizing Valves, LSV & USV Seals, Hydraulic Mud Gun Plugging
Device (Water Cooled Design), Clay Barrel (Supply & Refurbishment), Mud Gun Centre Joint, Link Arm,
Link Lever, Mud Gun Slewing Cylinder (Manufacturing & Refurbishment), Vertical Chute, Distribution
Chute, Refurbishment of HBSV water cooled flange and the complete Hot Blast Valve Package.

In addition to the above, Thermion Corporation offers end-to-end solutions including engineering
support, design optimization, indigenous manufacturing, refurbishment services, and on-site
technical assistance. Our focus lies in enhancing equipment reliability, extending service life, and
reducing downtime through robust design and high-quality materials suited for severe operating
conditions.

We work closely with reputed global technology partners to ensure compliance with international
standards and customer-specific technical requirements. Our in-house capabilities, coupled with a
strong vendor base, allow us to execute projects with short lead times while maintaining strict
quality control.

Thermion Corporation has been at the forefront of providing cost-effective solution to a broad
spectrum of customers.

Our assurance to customers has always been that “We and our partners in business are a bunch of
positive minded, focussed team working towards tailor made innovative solutions and therefore can be
rest assured that their requirements are in hands of a quality team with the best customer service
in the Industry.”

## INTRODUCING THE TRAPSHED BRAND DOG PROOF RACCOON TRAP

The TrapShed Brand Dog Proof Raccoon Trap is ready to use out of the box. Our flagship trap features
heavy duty machine chain with multiple in-line swivels, heavy duty coilsprings, and a pull-only
style trigger. All powder coated and ready to use. Choose from black or white. 

Set it, anchor it, and check it. It's that simple. When a raccoon reaches in to grab and pull the
bait out of the tube the trap will fire. Suitable for raccoon, skunk, and opossum. 

**Use with our **[**Sticky Fingerz Raccoon Bait**][336]** for excellent results.**

#### We are proud to bring you our inaugural offering of trapping baits & lures.  We have heard from

## INTRODUCING THE TRAPSHED BRAND DOG PROOF RACCOON TRAP

The TrapShed Brand Dog Proof Raccoon Trap is ready to use out of the box. Our flagship trap features
heavy duty machine chain with multiple in-line swivels, heavy duty coilsprings, and a pull-only
style trigger. All powder coated and ready to use. Choose from black or white. 

Set it, anchor it, and check it. It's that simple. When a raccoon reaches in to grab and pull the
bait out of the tube the trap will fire. Suitable for raccoon, skunk, and opossum. 

**Use with our **[**Sticky Fingerz Raccoon Bait**][336]** for excellent results.**
